title: What If Your Salary Doubled Every Month?

scenes.text: Month 1. Your boss slides a paycheck across the desk. Three thousand dollars.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.text: Same as last month. Wake me up when it gets interesting.
scenes.speaker: friend
scenes.bgIdea: same office, friend leaning on the next desk

scenes.text: But from today, there's a new rule. Every month, your salary doubles.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.bgIdea: office, a glowing x2 appears above the desk

scenes.text: Loser washes the other one's car for a year. I say you blow it all by Christmas.
scenes.speaker: friend
scenes.bgIdea: office, the two shake hands on the bet

scenes.text: Month 12. Your paycheck is six million dollars. In hundred dollar bills, it weighs about sixty kilograms.
scenes.speaker: narrator

scenes.text: What if your salary doubled every month?
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.title: WHAT IF YOUR SALARY DOUBLED EVERY MONTH?

factCheck: Bills = 6,144,000 / 100 = 61,440; a US bill weighs about 1 g, so about 61 kg
sources: US Bureau of Engraving and Printing: each note weighs about 1 gram - https://www.bep.gov
